items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: when he come here with our band

ctx.x: And when I came back to Noir on the boat, I went to see him close, David went to New York. And when he learned that stuff in New York, so when he come here with our band, he know the whole lot of stuff that the college didn't know. So he learned that double beatin' that fast time and all like that and the people liked it, you see.
